diffs.diff: pin count: part has 16 (EN MS1 MS2 NC PDN_UART CLK STEP DIR VM GND OA2 OA1 OB1 OB2 VIO GND2), datasheet reading has 15 (EN MS1 MS2 PDN_UART CLK STEP DIR VM GND 2B 2A 1A 1B VIO GND)
diffs.evidence: The board has 16 physical header pins (2 x 8). Schematic TMC2208-V3.0SCH.pdf (Watterott SilentStepStick-TMC2208_v12 design): JP1 pin 8 EN, 7 MS1, 6 MS2, 5 -> J2 pad 3 only, 4 -> J2 pad 1 (J2 centre pad 2 = PDN_UART), 3 -> J1 -> CLK, 2 STEP, 1 DIR; JP2 pin 1 VM, 2 GND, 3 OA2, 4 OA1, 5 OB1, 6 OB2, 7 VIO, 8 GND. The BTT V3.0 pinout image (TMC2208_Pin) labels EN, MS1, MS2, an unlabelled pin, PDN UART, CLK, STEP, DIR on one side and VM GND OA2 OA1 OB1 OB2 VIO GND on the other. The second reading dropped the unlabelled 4th pin (NC, only reaches one side of solder jumper J2) and used generic 2B/2A/1A/1B coil names; the model uses the board's own silkscreen OA2/OA1/OB1/OB2 in the same positions, and GND2 is the second printed GND (next to VIO).

diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 4.75 V
diffs.evidence: The part's vmin/vmax describe the supply the microcontroller provides, which is VIO. TMC220x datasheet section 18.1 Operational Range: 'I/O supply voltage VVIO 3.00 min 5.25 max V' (part has 3.0-5.25 V). The 4.75 V figure is the motor supply VS from the front-page 'Voltage Range 4.75... 36V DC' (and the same table gives VVS 5.5-36 V using the internal +5V regulator, as on this board), a separate motor supply the model documents on the VM pin (5.5-35 V) and in buildNotes, not the logic rail.
